items.description:
Codfather Seafood & Sushi is a restaurant in Camps Bay, Cape Town, serving an extensive menu of fresh fish, shellfish and innovative sushi. The range includes prawns, oysters, langoustines and crayfish, alongside tender Falkland's calamari and a wide variety of fresh linefish, chosen for freshness, quality and variety.

For a quieter and more intimate meal, guests can dine in the restaurant's exclusive Wine Cellar, surrounded by thousands of bottles of wine. The restaurant describes itself as one of the most reviewed restaurants on TripAdvisor, reflecting its standing among visitors to Camps Bay. Guests can book a table online ahead of their visit. It suits diners who want a wide seafood and sushi selection with the option of a more private wine cellar setting.

Coronation Bazaar is a long-running general store at the crossroads of Coronation and Melbourne Roads in Walmer Estate, Cape Town, trading from a baby-blue building dated 1935. A VoiceMap audio tour of the neighbourhood stops at the shop and notes that, since there are no major shopping malls or retail outlets nearby, corner cafes like this one are common in Walmer Estate.

The tour explains that most of the area's shop owners have lived and operated their businesses here for more than 50 years, with many originally coming from District Six before it was declared a white-only area in the 1960s. Coronation Bazaar is part of that same community history, trading through decades of change in the neighbourhood. It suits visitors interested in the area's history as much as locals doing everyday shopping.

Debonairs Pizza Mitchells Plain Express is a branch of the national Debonairs Pizza chain trading from Shop 8 in Town Centre on Katdoring Street, Mitchells Plain. The outlet serves the brand's Triple-Decker and Real Deal pizza ranges alongside chicken meals, prepared for collection, delivery or eating in.

It offers catering and counter service, with a family-friendly dining area as well as online ordering for delivery. Trading hours vary by day, so it is worth checking before a visit rather than assuming a fixed schedule. It suits local residents and families in Mitchells Plain who want a quick pizza or chicken meal, whether collected, delivered or eaten on site.

items.description:
Den Anker Restaurant & Bar is a Belgian restaurant and bar on the Pierhead at the V&A Waterfront, trading since 1994 and now a harbour fixture of more than three decades. The kitchen serves Belgian classics such as moules marinieres, fresh tuna and steak au poivre, alongside mussels, bitterballen and pommes frites, with a wide selection of imported Belgian beers to match.

Its terrace looks out over the working harbour, giving diners a view across the water while they eat. The restaurant trades from the Pierhead at the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town. It suits visitors and harbour-goers after Belgian food and beer with a view of the boats coming and going.

Deon Stuart Electronics and Installations is a security and installations business at 4 Ventura Street in Rocklands, Mitchells Plain, with 25 years of experience in the field. The business offers alarm systems, CCTV surveillance, garage and gate automation and related electronic security installations.

Its directory listing shows the business trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:30, closed on weekends. Customers can contact the business by phone or send an email enquiry through its listing. It suits homeowners and businesses in Rocklands and Mitchells Plain who want an experienced local installer for alarms, CCTV or automated gates. The listing lets customers write a review or report incorrect details directly on the page.

Department of Coffee is a coffee shop on Ntlazane Street in Khayelitsha, Cape Town, described in a Cape Town Etc feature as the Mother City's only official township coffee shop. The article notes that visitors can get the same rich quality coffee they might expect elsewhere, but in a completely different setting from the usual cafe.

The feature describes how tourists visit the shop to get a sense of the black community of Khayelitsha while enjoying their coffee exactly the way they like it, something the writer says had the whole city of Cape Town gasping in surprise when the shop first opened. It suits visitors and locals who want good coffee along with a genuine taste of life in Khayelitsha.

items.description:
District Six Museum is a heritage museum on Buitenkant Street documenting the history of District Six and the forced removals that emptied the neighbourhood under apartheid. It was launched in 1994 following years of work by the District Six Museum Foundation, and today runs exhibitions, oral history projects and educational programmes alongside its core heritage work.

Visitors can explore on a self-guided basis or pre-book a tour led by a former resident of the area, giving a first-hand account of the community's history, and the museum also runs school programmes and site walks as part of its public education work. It is on Buitenkant Street in Cape Town. It suits tourists, researchers, school groups and anyone wanting to hear District Six's history from people who lived it.

items.reason: The practice's about page names and describes its dentist, Dr Clarisa Podges, which this field cannot use since naming a person in the description is not allowed. No other usable facts could support a description without naming her.

items.description:
Durbanville Fisheries is a fish and chips takeaway trading from Shop 20 in Durbanville Town Centre on Wellington Road, Durbanville. The shop fries fresh fish bought from recognised fish merchants and hand-cuts its own potatoes for slap chips, alongside calamari, prawns and other seafood dishes such as hake and snoek.

Orders can be placed ahead for collection, and the shop also delivers through Mr D for customers who would rather eat at home. It trades from Durbanville Town Centre in Durbanville, and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and Saturdays from 8am to 4pm. It suits anyone after a classic takeaway fish and chips meal in the northern suburbs, whether eating in, collecting or having it delivered.

El Burro is a Mexican tapas-style restaurant at 79 Main Road in Green Point, Cape Town, serving dishes inspired by the owners' travels across Mexico. The menu is prepared fresh daily, with hand-pressed corn tortillas, fresh salsas and freshly squeezed lime juice used for its margaritas.

The Green Point branch trades Monday to Saturday from midday to 23:30 and Sundays from midday to 21:00, and it does not take reservations. El Burro also has a sister branch on Kloof Nek in Tamboerskloof, and the brand sells Cabrito and Centinela tequila at retail. It suits diners who want casual Mexican food and margaritas without needing to book ahead.

Epping Property is an industrial property brokerage based in Thornton, Cape Town, specialising in the Epping Industria area. Its site describes Epping Industria as one of Cape Town's most established and strategically important industrial areas, playing a central role in the city's manufacturing, warehousing and logistics sector for more than 70 years.

The agency publishes guides for business owners looking to buy or rent industrial space, noting that Cape Town's industrial property market is undergoing a major transformation as demand for the right type of space continues to grow. It helps clients navigate a market where finding the right building, in the right location, at the right price can be difficult. It suits businesses looking to buy or rent factory, warehouse or industrial premises in the Epping area.

Equibox is an equestrian supplies shop in Noordhoek, Cape Town, stocking gear for both horse and rider. For the horse, the range covers rugs, bridles, saddles, horse boots, headcollars and fly protection gear, while riders can choose from jodhpurs, breeches, riding jackets, yard and riding boots, hats and waterproof clothing.

Customers can shop in person at the store or order online, with nationwide delivery available alongside in-store collection, so riders further afield can still get hold of gear without visiting in person. The shop trades in Noordhoek, Cape Town, and is open seven days a week from 9am to 5pm. It suits riders and horse owners looking to browse equestrian gear in person or have it delivered.

Ergonomics Direct is a supplier of ergonomic office furniture, seating and accessories on Carlisle Street in Paarden Eiland, Cape Town. Its range runs from ergonomic chairs, including the adjustable Ergo Elevator and the heavy-duty Ergo Plus, to sit-stand desks, laptop and monitor stands, footrests, keyboards and other desk accessories, alongside dedicated industrial ergonomics products.

Beyond selling furniture, the business offers office and industrial ergonomics consulting, helping workplaces set up seating and desks that reduce strain and improve comfort. It trades from Carlisle Street in Paarden Eiland, Cape Town, with products also available to browse and buy online. It suits home-office users, businesses and organisations wanting ergonomic seating, desks or consulting advice for a more comfortable workplace.

Estora Home is a furniture retailer with a showroom at Unit A103 in The Palms Decor and Lifestyle Centre on Sir Lowry Road, Woodstock. It sells modern couches, beds, coffee and side tables and outdoor furniture, manufactured in Johannesburg and sold directly to customers rather than through third-party retailers.

Most pieces can be customised, with more than 100 fabric options to match a customer's own interior, furniture made from high-quality materials, and a manufacturing lead time of three to four weeks. The showroom trades from The Palms Decor and Lifestyle Centre in Woodstock, Cape Town. It suits homeowners furnishing or upgrading a living space who want a customisable couch or furniture piece bought directly from the manufacturer.

Exclusive Books is a South African bookstore chain that has operated since 1951, with this branch trading from Shop 6160 in Victoria Wharf at the V&A Waterfront. The store carries an extensive range of books, magazines and gifts, with an in-store cafe for browsing over a coffee.

As one of the Waterfront's established retail tenants, it draws a mix of shoppers, tourists and book lovers passing through Victoria Wharf. The branch trades from Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre at the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town, and is open daily from 9am to 9pm. It suits anyone looking for a wide book selection, a gift, or a coffee and a browse while at the Waterfront.

FPS Attorneys is a law firm in Brackenfell offering legal services and consultations to individuals, businesses and the wider community. The firm says its approach centres on understanding each client's needs and developing proactive strategies, concentrating on specific areas of law rather than a broad generalist practice.

Consultations can be arranged by video call as well as in person, making the practice accessible to clients who cannot get to the office easily. FPS Attorneys trades from Gert Kotze Street in Brackenfell, Cape Town. It describes itself as serving both legal and non-legal communities, and takes part in pro bono and community activities alongside its client work.

Golden Arrow Bus Services, commonly known as Golden Arrow or GABS, is a public transport bus operator headquartered at 103 Bofors Circle in Epping, Cape Town. Founded in 1861, the company is one of two major public transport bus operators in the city and is owned via Frontier Transport Holdings, part of Hosken Consolidated Investments.

The company runs around 1,300 routes with a fleet of about 1,300 buses, including both diesel and electric vehicles, serving around seven hubs across the metro. Its daily ridership is about 230,000 passengers, making it one of the city's most heavily used transport services. It suits commuters across Cape Town who rely on Golden Arrow's extensive bus network for daily travel.

Good Thyme Cafe is a cafe inside Stodels Garden Centre on Racecourse Road in Milnerton, Cape Town, classified as serving international and healthy cuisine across breakfast, lunch, brunch and dinner. It offers table service and takes reservations, and describes itself simply as the local cafe in the heart of Milnerton for coffee, breakfast and lunch.

Good Thyme Cafe trades from Stodels Garden Centre in Milnerton, and is open daily from 8am to 5pm. It suits garden-centre visitors and local residents wanting a relaxed breakfast, brunch or lunch stop, whether popping in for a coffee or settling in for a full meal.

items.description:
Hypermed Pharmacy is an Alpha Pharm-affiliated retail pharmacy on the corner of York and Main Road in Green Point, Cape Town. The pharmacy runs a dispensary for prescription medicines alongside a wider range of general health, wellness and beauty products for the local community.

It is listed as a seven-day pharmacy, trading every day of the week including weekends, which suits customers needing prescriptions or health products outside typical weekday hours. As part of the Alpha Pharm group, it carries the buying power and product range of a larger network while still serving as a neighbourhood pharmacy. Hypermed Pharmacy trades from the corner of York and Main Road in Green Point. It suits Green Point residents and visitors wanting a nearby pharmacy for dispensing, wellness and beauty needs.

Jumbo Cash & Carry in Ottery is a bulk wholesale store on Old Ottery Road, part of the Massmart-owned Jumbo chain, stocking groceries, household goods and general merchandise for independent traders and the public. The branch takes part in the chain's regular catalogue specials, alongside its everyday bulk stock.

It trades from Old Ottery Road in Ottery, Cape Town, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Saturdays from 8am to 3pm and Sundays from 8am to 1pm. It suits traders buying in bulk as well as members of the public after everyday groceries and household goods at wholesale prices.

Kristen's Kick-Ass Ice Cream is an ice-cream shop in Noordhoek Farm Village, Cape Town, making its product by hand in small batches using local dairy and sustainable ingredients sourced in South Africa. All flavours are made from scratch in the kitchen above the shop, where nuts are toasted, fruits are roasted and caramel is swirled by hand.

The shop also bakes its own 'Oreos' for the Cookies & Cream flavour, and guests can order scoops, takeaway tubs, waffles or cookies. It is open daily from 9am to 5pm. It suits families and visitors to the Farm Village who want handmade ice cream using quality local ingredients.

La Femme Health & Beauty Salon is a beauty salon at the Noordhoek Garden Emporium, on the corner of Noordhoek Main Road and Katzenellenbogen Street, that has been operating in the area for more than 20 years. Its treatments cover massages, manicures, pedicures, gel toes and other nail work, along with waxing and general beauty care.

The salon trades from the Noordhoek Garden Emporium in Noordhoek, Cape Town, Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 1pm. It suits anyone in the Noordhoek area wanting an established salon for massages, manicures, pedicures or other beauty treatments.

Little Fox is a restaurant at the historic Constantia Nek site in Constantia, opened in February 2026 as the more casual sibling of Foxcroft under the La Colombe group. Where Foxcroft serves a fixed tasting menu, Little Fox offers a la carte small and sharing plates for a more relaxed, flexible meal.

Seating extends from the main dining room into a leafy courtyard at the Constantia Nek site, giving diners an outdoor option alongside indoor tables. The restaurant trades from Constantia Nek in Constantia, Cape Town, for lunch and dinner seven days a week. It suits groups, couples and diners wanting a relaxed alternative to fine dining without leaving the Constantia Nek site.

LNR Computers is a computer hardware and IT services store at Shop 4 in Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre, Plattekloof, that has served Cape Town customers since 1991. It supplies computer hardware, software and peripherals alongside professional technical support, including system upgrades, virus removal, screen replacement and custom-built computers.

Its data-recovery service carries a no-recovery, no-charge guarantee, and the store serves corporate, government, educational and private customers, with call-out repairs available for those who cannot get to the shop. LNR Computers trades from Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre in Plattekloof, Cape Town, Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 4pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm. It suits anyone from home users to businesses needing computer repairs, upgrades or a new custom-built machine.

items.description:
Lotz of Joy Guesthouse is a seven-bedroom guesthouse at 70 Panorama Road in Panorama, Cape Town, with en-suite bathrooms, bar fridges, televisions and free Wi-Fi in each room. It also offers free parking, breakfast and a liquor licence, so guests can have a drink or a meal without needing to go out.

The guesthouse is close to Panorama Mediclinic and a short drive from the Tygervalley, Willowbridge and Canal Walk shopping centres. Lotz of Joy Guesthouse trades from Panorama Road in Panorama, Cape Town. It suits business travellers and tourists after accommodation in the northern suburbs, within reach of shopping, dining and medical facilities.

M&L Panelbeaters is a family-owned panelbeating and spray-painting workshop in Elsie's River that has repaired vehicles in Cape Town since 1984. It is a manufacturer-approved motor body repair centre, holding factory sanctions from a number of vehicle manufacturers, so repairs are carried out to the standards those manufacturers require rather than a generic approach.

Alongside panelbeating and spray-painting, the workshop handles general mechanical repairs and assists customers with insurance claims after an accident, dealing directly with insurers on a client's behalf where needed. M&L Panelbeaters trades from Sixth Avenue in Elsie's River, Cape Town. It suits private vehicle owners, insurers and corporate clients needing accident repairs carried out to manufacturer-approved standards.

Malok is a homegrown South African clothing brand based at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, Cape Town. The brand describes itself as honest and homegrown, creating beautiful, classic, feminine and versatile pieces without compromising on comfort, using simple lines and contemporary designs.

Its garments are made from natural fabrics chosen to be easier on the environment and friendlier on the skin, and every piece is ethically designed and produced in the brand's own studio and boutique at the Old Biscuit Mill. Malok has also opened a sister shop called Malok Lifestyle, where it curates products from a group of talented local creatives. It suits shoppers who want locally made, sustainably produced womenswear from a Cape Town brand.

Mango Ginger is a coffee shop and bakery in Observatory, Cape Town, open since 2006 and known for delicious, nutritious, homemade food. It is open for breakfast and lunch, with fresh bakery counters, wholesome plates, coffee and prepared meals customers can take home.

Signature dishes on its menu include a Vegan Bounty Bowl, a gluten-free and sugar-free coconut lemon cheesecake finished with berry brightness, eggs Benedict with poached eggs and warm hollandaise, and a matcha latte. The cafe specialises in gluten-free, sugar-free and vegan options alongside its regular menu, and it also offers catering. It suits health-conscious diners in Observatory who want a wholesome breakfast or lunch with gluten-free and vegan choices.

Marble is a fire-cooking restaurant on the top floor of the historic Union Castle Building at the V&A Waterfront, created by a chef whose original Johannesburg restaurant has been a celebration of fire cooking, carefully sourced meat and classic South African flavours since it opened in 2016. The Cape Town branch, developed with a business partner, reimagines the historic building with wrap-around rooftop glass-walled views of Table Mountain, the working harbour and the Atlantic Ocean.

The restaurant continues the signature Marble style, with the chef adding a touch of Cape Town to the concept. It offers a real destination feel, built around the experience and vibe of the space as much as the food itself. It suits diners who want fire-cooked dishes paired with some of the best views at the Waterfront.

Martins Bakery is a bakery, deli and coffee shop at 43 Main Road in Diep River, Cape Town, established by Firmino Martins in 1970 as a local convenience store then known as Steurhof Cafe. His successor John Martins followed in his father's footsteps and opened the bakery division in 1983, after leaving his job as a bank manager to follow his passion, and he now runs it with his wife.

The European-style bakery offers healthy and homemade goods, including gluten-free, wheat-free, sugar-free and banting products, alongside farm-style breakfasts and lunches and a large selection of cakes. It bakes non-commercial, homemade breads with no preservatives, using traditional techniques such as sourdough. It suits health-conscious customers in the southern suburbs who want fresh baking and a relaxed deli menu.

Mediclinic Constantiaberg is a private hospital on Burnham Road in Plumstead, providing 24-hour medical treatment through its emergency centre and a range of specialist services. Its Mother and Child Unit covers obstetrics, neonatal critical care and paediatrics, while other departments handle neuroscience, epilepsy and haematology, including bone-marrow services.

The hospital also runs supplementary services including pathology, CT, MRI, 3D and 4D radiology, and an on-site pharmacy, so patients can access most of their care under one roof. Mediclinic Constantiaberg trades from Burnham Road in Plumstead, Cape Town. It suits private patients, including families needing maternity or paediatric care, and anyone requiring emergency or specialist hospital treatment in the southern suburbs.

Moksh Indian Restaurant is a North Indian restaurant in the FNB Building on Main Road in Plumstead, serving tandoor-cooked dishes and curries for lunch and dinner. It offers family-style dining, with takeaway and delivery available for customers who would rather eat at home.

The restaurant also caters for private parties, birthdays and corporate functions, making it an option for groups booking a function alongside its regular a la carte service. Moksh Indian Restaurant trades from the FNB Building on Main Road in Plumstead, Cape Town, and takes reservations. It suits families, groups and anyone after North Indian cuisine for a casual meal or a booked function in the southern suburbs.

Montague Gardens Hardware and Steel is a hardware and steel fabrication business at 20 Montague Drive in Montague Gardens, Cape Town, founded in 1976. It began as a modest woodworking workshop and has expanded over the decades into steel fabrication, becoming the business known today.

The company sits in Cape Town's Montague Gardens industrial precinct, prized for its location near the N1 and N7 highways and its proximity to Cape Town International Airport, surrounded by other established businesses and distribution hubs. Its range covers hardware and DIY essentials, including tools, galvanised pipe fittings, stainless-steel bolts and nuts, safety gear, drill bits and garden kits. It suits tradespeople and DIY customers who need hardware supplies alongside custom steel fabrication work.

Mr O's Motor Spares is a motor vehicle parts and accessories retailer trading from Total Garage in Portlands, Mitchells Plain. The shop stocks replacement parts and spares for a range of vehicle makes and models, with customers regularly enquiring about parts for specific cars they are repairing.

Alongside selling parts over the counter, the business runs an in-house workshop offering fitment services for what it sells, so customers can have parts fitted on the spot rather than taking them elsewhere. Mr O's Motor Spares trades from Total Garage in Portlands, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town. It suits motorists and vehicle owners looking for replacement parts along with fitment in one visit.

items.description:
Parow Family Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy on the corner of Jan van Riebeeck and Voortrekker Road in Parow, Cape Town, that opened to the public on 27 November 2002. The pharmacy offers extended hours, free deliveries and a trusted community focus, aiming to make its customers' health journey more accessible and personal.

Its pharmacist describes travelling regularly to pharmaceutical congresses to stay current with new treatments and best practice, and says that operating a good pharmacy depends on a dedicated team of pharmacists, assistants, nurses and staff who share a passion for helping people. The pharmacy says a healthy community is a happy one, and it sees helping customers stay healthy as its most important mission. It suits residents of Parow who want personal, community-focused pharmacy care.

Partners Hair Design is a hair salon at Shop 66, Gardens Centre, on Mill Street in Gardens, Cape Town. It serves clients from Gardens, Oranjezicht, Tamboerskloof, De Waal Park and the wider City Bowl, with a team of professionally trained stylists.

Services cover the full range of hair work, from precision haircuts and colour treatments to keratin smoothing, scalp treatments and specialist curl services. Walk-ins are welcome for cuts and blow-dries, while colour and treatments are best booked ahead. The salon trades from 9am to 6pm. It suits anyone in the City Bowl who wants precision cuts, colour or specialist curl care close to Gardens Centre.

items.description:
Pho Thy is a halal-certified Vietnamese restaurant on Kenilworth's Main Road, in a cosy and unfussy setting. Its name is pronounced Faa-Thee, and it is the sister restaurant of Pho & Bun in Diep River, with a very similar menu of pho, the brothy, fresh Vietnamese soup served in chicken or beef versions.

The restaurant serves authentic Vietnamese dishes with fresh ingredients, and it trades from 10:00 to 21:00, Monday to Saturday. Its price range is listed as cheap to medium, from under R100 to around R300 per person. It suits diners looking for an affordable, authentic bowl of pho or other Vietnamese dishes in Kenilworth.

items.description:
PostNet in Gardens Shopping Centre is a branch of the national PostNet printing, courier and stationery franchise, trading from Shop 50 on the ground floor of Gardens Shopping Centre on Mill Street, Gardens. The branch offers copy and print services, courier bookings, stationery and digital services for individuals, students and businesses.

It handles domestic and international courier needs alongside everyday printing and stationery requirements, giving customers a single stop for office and personal errands. PostNet trades from Gardens Shopping Centre in Gardens, Cape Town, Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 2pm. It suits individuals, students and businesses in the City Bowl needing courier, printing or stationery services close by.
